progression: September 2026 English full-time Free Major. Year 1 core is 35 EC: skills 10, research 10, CMS choice 10, project 5. Major 25 EC: one methods elective plus four approved introductory or methods choices.

Year 2 adds 15 EC Academic Core and 45 EC Major (two methods courses and seven level 200/300 or methods courses). Select different eligible courses and respect course-level prerequisites and the Mathematics/Calculus 1 exclusion.

Year 3 contains the 30 EC minor, two 300-level major electives, a 15 EC thesis and a 5 EC project. A University Minor or approved personal minor fills the minor space; an internship can account for 15 EC within the approved personal minor.

September entrants first access the thesis in semester six. Completing years 1 and 2 meets the 60 first-year plus 60 later EC credit conditions before thesis supervision. The Board must approve the programme. The specific compulsory course orders in art. 9.3 apply to choices; no prescribed restricted elective is named in this route. The Venice double-degree route has a separate structure and is outside this neutral example.
